verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a payments platform could expose transaction and payout data for ledger reconciliation, but the evidence documents no API for retrieving transactions, settlement details or payouts. The closest items fall short: transaction management in the Customer Area UI, payout-schedule configuration, generic webhooks for payment outcomes, and an MCP server described only as a way to build payment solutions. None of these shows an agent pulling transaction or payout data to reconcile daily takings.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull transactions and payouts via API and reconcile daily takings into my ledger
